topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text: I found a piece of parchment in my wife's chest, hidden under the old linens. It had her scrawls, all the places she dreams of seeing, the things she yearns to do. Markets in distant towns, festivals I’ve never heard of, maybe even crossing the mountains. I toil in these fields, day in and day out, and what does she do? Dreams of leaving, wandering off, while the land needs tending, the barn needs fixing. Saints preserve us, what good is a bucket list if the well runs dry and the crops fail? She thinks of far-off lands, but I reckon our future is right here, in this dirt, under this sky.
